# Blankie ambient audio

The bundled recordings come from [Blankie by Cody Bromley and contributors](https://github.com/codybrom/blankie).
SHBUI uses the [M4A files at revision 53c58f4b73f6491e826be81e64c820dec9a256dc](https://github.com/codybrom/blankie/tree/53c58f4b73f6491e826be81e64c820dec9a256dc/Blankie/Resources/Sounds).
Blankie publishes the [original credits and license for each sound](https://blankie.rest/credits/#sound-credits).

SHBUI trimmed each recording to a short excerpt, crossfaded its loop seam over 0.9 seconds, adjusted gain, and re-encoded it as stereo 44.1 kHz Ogg Vorbis.
